open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 OffsetTimeOriginal validation
open_points.text: minutes that are a minute of the hour
open_points.question: Which two-digit minute values make an EXIF offset usable: only 00 through 59, every 00 through 99 value admitted by EXIF_OFFSET_PATTERN, or some other set?
options: Every two-digit value 00 through 99 is valid if the hour is within CAMERA_OFFSET_MAX_HOURS.
Use the standard library's offset parser to decide validity.

witness.initial: The run timezone is Europe/Madrid; a file has DateTimeOriginal 2026:07:01 12:00:00, OffsetTimeOriginal +05:60, no EXIF DateTime, and modification time 2026-07-02T00:00:00 UTC.
events: photo_preparation validates OffsetTimeOriginal against EXIF_OFFSET_PATTERN and the additional hour-and-minute condition.
photo_preparation chooses the photo moment and builds the publication date.
outcomes: Treat 60 as outside the minute range, ignore the offset, and interpret DateTimeOriginal in Europe/Madrid, producing 2026-07-01T10:00:00 UTC.

Treat the regex-matching offset as selected; its conversion cannot be represented, so DateTimeOriginal is unusable and the file modification time becomes the photo moment, producing 2026-07-02T00:00:00 UTC.
witness.observer: The calling agent and owner see a different photo_date in the publication body.
